name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new option, endpoint or capability
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: unmanarc
---

## Problem

What are you trying to do that the current version makes hard or impossible?

## Proposed solution

Describe the behavior, option name or HTTP endpoint you would like. If it is a new
command line switch, suggest the long/short name and the expected default.

```bash
uPocketWS --new-option <value>
```

## Alternatives considered

Existing options, workarounds, or other tools you already tried.

## Scope check

This project aims to stay small and dependency free. Please confirm:

- [ ] The feature does not require a new runtime dependency
- [ ] The feature does not require a configuration file (command line switches only)
- [ ] The feature is scoped to a directory allow-list, like the existing capabilities

## Additional context

Mockups, links to similar implementations, references to the HTTP/CGI specs, etc.
